high.label: High confidence
high.description: Reliable evidence from a primary or strongly verified source.

medium.label: Medium confidence
medium.description: Credible evidence that still benefits from confirmation.
examples: Clear user measurement supported by photos
Standard-code inference supported by other evidence

low.label: Low confidence
low.description: Weak or approximate evidence that should not be treated as final proof.

unverified.label: Unverified
unverified.description: Unsupported information that cannot be trusted without stronger evidence.

evidenceRecordSchema.description: Field-level evidence records used by the rule engine and physical-fit model.

policyNotes: Evidence confidence describes the reliability of an input fact.
Evidence confidence does not describe compatibility.
Missing evidence should trigger review, not a guessed pass or blocking fail.
